# Scan this document for packages loaded via library(), require(), pkg::fun(), etc.
src <- file.path(Sys.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_PATH"), Sys.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE"))
pkgs <- renv::dependencies(src, progress = FALSE)$Package

# Drop base R packages and tooling used only for rendering/this chunk
base_pkgs <- rownames(installed.packages(priority = "base"))
pkgs <- sort(setdiff(unique(pkgs), c(base_pkgs, "renv", "knitr", "rmarkdown", "quarto")))

# Wrap the quoted package names to a fixed width
pkg_lines <- paste0('"', pkgs, '"', collapse = ", ")

# Report packages to install
cat("::: {.callout-note title='Packages used in this module'}\n```r\n")
cat("install.packages(c(", pkg_lines, "))\n", sep = "")
